title: Amazon SQS Integration With Amazon Redshift using Amazon EventBridge Pipes
description: How to send messages from Amazon SQS queue to Amazon Redshift Cluster using Amazon EventBridge Pipes

introBox.headline: How it works
text: The solution will create two Amazon SQS queues, Amazon Redshift Cluster, and an EventBridge Pipes.
EventBridge pipes consume messages from source SQS queue then transform the message to create an insert queries and insert data to Amazon Redshift cluster.
